abstract: Sperm chromosome abnormalities were assessed in testicular cancer patients before and after treatment with BEP (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin). The frequencies of disomy for chromosomes 1, 12, X, Y and XY were assessed along with diploid frequencies and sex ratios by multicolour fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH). For each cancer patient, a minimum of 10,000 sperm was assessed for each chromosome probe before and after chemotherapy (CT). Data was analysed "blindly" by coding the slides. A total of 161097 sperm were analyzed, 80,445 before and 80,642 after treatment. The mean disomy frequencies were 0.11% pre-CT vs 0.06% post-CT for chromosome 1, 0.18% vs 0.15% for chromosome 12, 0.10% vs 0.9% for the X chromosome, 0.13% vs 0.10% for the Y chromosome and 0.25% vs 0.20% for XY sperm. There was no significant difference in the frequency of disomy pre-CT vs post-CT for any chromosome except that chromosome 1 demonstrated a significant decrease after CT. The "sex ratios" and frequency of diploid sperm were also not significantly different in pre and post-CT samples with 50.2% X-bearing sperm pre-CT and 50.5% X post-CT and 0.14% diploid sperm pre-CT vs 0.15% diploid sperm post-CT. There was no significant donor heterogeneity among the cancer patients. None of the values in the cancer patients differed significantly from 10 normal control donors. Thus our study suggests that BEP chemotherapy does not increase the risk of numerical chromosomal abnormalities in human sperm.
abstract_ja: 精子の染色体異常を、BEP療法(ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチン)の前後の精巣がん患者で評価した。第1、12、X、Y染色体およびXY精子のdisomy頻度、倍数体頻度、性比を多色蛍光in situハイブリダイゼーション(FISH)法で測定した。各患者について、染色体プローブごとに化学療法前後でそれぞれ少なくとも10,000個の精子を解析した。スライドはコード化して盲検的に解析した。総計161,097個の精子を解析し、化学療法前が80,445個、後が80,642個であった。第1染色体のdisomy頻度の平均は化学療法前0.11%、後0.06%、第12染色体は0.18%対0.15%、X染色体は0.10%対0.9%、Y染色体は0.13%対0.10%、XY精子は0.25%対0.20%であった。第1染色体のみ化学療法後に有意な減少を認めたが、その他の染色体では前後で有意差はなかった。性比と倍数体精子の頻度も前後で有意差はなかった(X保有精子は化学療法前50.2%、後50.5%、倍数体精子は0.14%対0.15%)。患者間に有意な個体差はなく、患者の値はいずれも対照の正常提供者10名と有意差がなかった。本研究の結果は、BEP化学療法が精子の数的染色体異常のリスクを高めないことを示唆する。
